description: This file contains utility functions for image processing, including padding and scaling images, with detailed implementation of image resizing using Catmull–Rom interpolation.

methods.name: padImageToSize
methods.description: Pads an image to a specified size by copying existing pixels and filling the rest with transparent black.

methods.name: scaleImageToSize
methods.description: Resizes an image to specified dimensions using Catmull–Rom interpolation for smooth scaling.
